items.description: The TODO item numbers the piece is about (#758 is 758); [] for none.

keywords.description: One text of three to ten words, separated by commas, that somebody would ask for this piece by and that are particular to it: the Korean words the room uses for the matter, names, product and system names, identifiers. None of the words every turn carries.

shared.description: On a knowledge chunk only: true for a chunk every room may read, false for one of this room alone.

title.description: One or two sentences, 40 to 320 characters: what kind of document the piece is and the situations a turn needs it for. Never a list of nouns.

pieces.description: Every piece that comes out of it, the original included where it stays.
